lines.japanese: 「おう、成田。俺は今から本社の方に用事あってもう戻って来ねえから、おまえ今から休憩入っとけ」
lines.english: “Narita. I've got business at headquarters and won't be back tonight, so take your break now.”

lines.japanese: 「うっす」
lines.english: “Got it.”

lines.japanese: ＡＭ２：００。ヒゲカンは俺への指示を残し、グレーのボロワゴンに乗って姿を消した。
lines.english: Two in the morning. Beardy left me those instructions, climbed into his battered gray wagon, and disappeared.

lines.japanese: 俺は詰所に行って居眠りでもしようかと思ったが、小腹が空いたので、コンビニへ買い物をしに行くことにした。
lines.english: I thought about going to the site office for a nap, but I was getting hungry, so I decided to make a run to the convenience store.

lines.japanese: 「森里君が思ったより元気そうでよかった」
lines.english: “I'm glad Morisato was doing better than I expected.”

lines.japanese: 病院で軽く森里君と雑談してから、工事現場のアルバイトにやってきた。今日は出るつもりなかったけど、彼のロンゲを見てたらなんとなく足が向いた。
lines.english: After shooting the breeze with Morisato at the hospital, I had come to work my construction shift. I hadn't planned on coming in today, but one look at that long hair of his had somehow sent my feet this way.

lines.japanese: ひとの顔を見て工事現場を思いだすってのは失礼かもしれないけど、足が向いちゃったんだから仕方ない。
lines.english: Maybe it was rude to look at somebody's face and immediately think of a construction site. Still, my feet had brought me here. Nothing I could do about that.

lines.japanese: 前髪を息で吹いてふわふわ浮かせながらでっかい橋脚の脇を抜けていく。この先に繁華街ならどこでも見つかる全国チェーンのコンビニが――
lines.english: I blew at my bangs and sent them fluttering as I passed an enormous bridge pier. Up ahead was one of those nationwide convenience-store chains you could find in any entertainment district—

lines.japanese: ――あるはずだったが、俺の視界は真正面からのハイビームを浴びせられて真っ白に覆われた。
lines.english: —or should have been, until a pair of high beams struck me head-on and drowned my vision in white.

lines.japanese: 「くっ、またあいつらか……」
lines.english: “Damn it. These assholes again...”

lines.japanese: 徐々に目が慣れてくると、涙目にも見える二つのヘッドランプ。機械的な光に人恋しそうな色を添えて、ご丁寧に俺の進行方向２００メートル先で停車した。
lines.english: As my eyes slowly adjusted, two headlamps emerged, looking almost tearful. Their mechanical glare took on a strangely lonesome cast as the vehicle came to a courteous stop two hundred meters straight ahead of me.

lines.japanese: 「イェア、一週間ぶりだな成田君！　そんだけの時間がありゃあ、よちよちベイブがメスの味を覚えちまうが、あんたのケツの穴は無事なのかい、ハッハー！」
lines.english: “Yeeah! Been a whole week, Narita! That's long enough for a toddling babe to get a taste for pussy. How's your asshole holding up? Hah-hah!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、この先のコンビニまでよろしく」
lines.english: “Oh. Give me a ride to the convenience store up ahead.”

lines.japanese: 俺はやつらが出てきた側と反対のドアから車に乗りこみ、助手席にどっかと腰を下ろした。
lines.english: I climbed in through the door opposite the one they had emerged from and dropped heavily into the passenger seat.

lines.japanese: 「オゥ、こいつはビビッたぜ成田君。俺の居ない隙にワイフに乗りこむたあ、そいつはちっとばかし節操ないんじゃねェのかい、メ～ン？」
lines.english: “Whoa, you gave me a scare, Narita. Climbing into my wife while I'm away? That's not exactly decent of you, maaaan.”

lines.japanese: 「ぶはーッ！　成田っち、あんたやっぱし速さが光だわー！　イ～ヨ、イ～ヨ、動きの早い男は嫌いじゃないヨ～」
lines.english: “Bwah! Narita, you really do move at light speed! Nice, nice—I like a man who moves quick!”

lines.japanese: 「ちょちょ、隼人先輩コンビニ行ってなに買うんスか！　自分もちっと腹減っててー、コンビニ弁当でもどーかと思ってたんスけど一緒にどスか！」
lines.english: “Whoa, whoa, Hayato! What're you getting at the store? I'm kinda hungry myself. I was thinking of grabbing a boxed lunch—wanna eat together?”

lines.japanese: 「俺ノリ弁」
lines.english: “Seaweed-and-rice lunch for me.”

lines.japanese: 「自分シャケすね！　今日は赤身が自分ンこと呼んでんスわ！　あと塩！」
lines.english: “Salmon for me! The red stuff's calling my name today! And salt!”

lines.japanese: 「塩。あ、塩味いいな、よし俺スルメも買おう」
lines.english: “Salt. Yeah, salty sounds good. All right, I'll get some dried squid too.”

lines.japanese: コンビニは数百メートル先だが、移動が楽なので、白いワゴンの助手席に座ってショッピングとしゃれ込んだ。
lines.english: The store was only a few hundred meters away, but riding was easier, so I settled into the white wagon's passenger seat and went shopping in style.

lines.japanese: 途中、連中が何度か話しかけてきたが、車内に響く低音がうるさくてまるで聞こえなかった。俺はあーとかおーとか適当に言いながらやつらが顔を向けてきた回数だけ頷いた。
lines.english: They tried talking to me a few times on the way, but the bass pounding through the car drowned out every word. I grunted at random and nodded whenever one of them turned toward me.

lines.japanese: で、結局買い物をして戻ってきた。
lines.english: Eventually, we finished our shopping and came back.

lines.japanese: 本当は職場から離れた場所に行きたかった。しかし弁当片手のギャル男がコンビニの前に座りこもうとするので、車の中に叩きこんでここに戻ってこさせた。
lines.english: I had wanted to eat somewhere away from work. Then the flashy club kid tried to squat outside the store with his boxed lunch, so I threw him back into the car and made them drive us here.

lines.japanese: 作業中の連中からは見えない位置に停車させて、ガードレールに腰かけながら話を聞いた。コンビニの前にたまるのと大して変わらないかもしれないが、営業妨害にならない分こっちのがマシだと思う。
lines.english: I had them park out of sight of the work crew, then perched on the guardrail and heard them out. Maybe it wasn't much better than loitering outside the store, but at least this way we weren't hurting anybody's business.

lines.japanese: 「ぶふっ、んもー、この寒空にガンモドキはたまらんわ～！　ね～え、成田チャンもそう思うでしょオ？」
lines.english: “Bwah! Mmm, a hot tofu fritter under this freezing sky—nothing beats it! Don’t you agree, Naritaaa?”

lines.japanese: 「だな。あー、俺もおでん買えばよかった。くそ、車内でこぼすとか気を使った俺がバカだった」
lines.english: “Yeah. Damn, I should've bought some hotpot too. I was an idiot to worry about spilling it in the car.”

lines.japanese: 「Ｕｈ……成田君、俺のワイフにそこまで愛情を注いでくれていたとは、クールな俺もソウルが滾るぜ、センキュウ・マイメン！」
lines.english: “Uh... Narita, to think you loved my wife enough to show such care... Even a cool cat like me can feel his soul catch fire. Thank you, my man!”

lines.japanese: 「いーや、隼人先輩マジ男だわ！　そりゃオンナにもモテるはずだわ、いま何人くらいカノジョいんスか！」
lines.english: “Nah, Hayato, you're seriously the man! No wonder the ladies love you. How many girlfriends've you got these days?”

lines.japanese: 「いたらおまえらと弁当なんか突付いてないだろうが」
lines.english: “If I had girlfriends, you think I'd be sitting here picking at boxed lunches with you assholes?”

lines.japanese: 「ひぎぃ！」
lines.english: “Eeeek!”

lines.japanese: 俺は弁当の代わりにやつの目玉を突付いた。
lines.english: Instead of his lunch, I poked him in the eye.

lines.japanese: 「アレレ～？　なんかこの前から、成田っち凶暴化してない？　もっかして、ま～た酔っぱらってんじゃないヨネ～？」
lines.english: “Oh myyy. Haven't you gotten awfully violent lately, Narita? You haven't gone and gotten drunk again, have youuu?”

lines.japanese: 「そうじゃないけど、どうせわざわざ俺のトコ来たってことは、なにかロクでもない話でもしに来たんだろ」
lines.english: “No. But you came all the way out here to see me, so I figured you had some stupid bullshit to drag me into.”

lines.japanese: 「ハハッ、なに言ってんだい成田君、俺たちゃあんたの顔が見たかっただけだぜ？」
lines.english: “Hah-hah! What are you talking about, Narita? We just wanted to see your face.”

lines.japanese: 「そうそう！　だって俺たち仲間ジャン！　そんなにカリカリしてねえでさあ、ほら、はんぺんあげるからさあ」
lines.english: “Exactly! We're buddies, aren't we? Stop being so prickly. Here, you can have my fish cake.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、マジで？　俺はんぺん大好きなんだけどいいの？　んめー、はんぺんマジうめー」
lines.english: “Seriously? I love fish cake. You're sure? Mm! God, this stuff is so good.”

lines.japanese: 「ナーニ言っちゃってんスか隼人先輩！　自分のシャケも半分あげますから！　こんなん隼人先輩が食いてえっつうなら、自分ぜーんぜん気にしないっスから」
lines.english: “What're you talking about, Hayato? I'll give you half my salmon too! If you want it, I don't mind one bit.”

lines.japanese: 「えええ、いいの？　だってシャケ弁からシャケ半分取ったら、ただのノーマル弁当だよ？　うわあ、ありがとういただきまーす」
lines.english: “Really? But if you take half the salmon out of a salmon lunch, it’s just a regular lunch. Wow, thanks! Don’t mind if I do.”

lines.japanese: 「さて、そんな皇帝好きの成田君ですが」
lines.english: “Now then, our emperor-loving Narita...”

lines.japanese: 「どんな話題の切りかえ方だ」
lines.english: “What the hell kind of transition is that?”

lines.japanese: 俺はもらったシャケを口の中に放りこみながら、ハゲのアメリカンドッグをおでんのつゆの中に突っこんだ。
lines.english: I tossed the donated salmon into my mouth and plunged Baldy's corn dog into the hotpot broth.

lines.japanese: 「ンＮＯおおお！　なーにしてくれやがんだこのファッキン・ガイ！　息子にヒューストンのヘドロをぶっかけられた気分だぜ！」
lines.english: “N-NOOO! What the hell did you do, you fuckin' guy! Feels like you poured Houston sludge all over my son!”

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、ちょーっ！　ＬＲさん、俺ら隼人先輩に皇帝と連絡とってもらうよう頼みに来たんスから！　それまではガン待ち鬼我慢でいきましょうって、さっきゆったじゃねースか！」
lines.english: “W-wait, LR! We came here to ask Hayato to put us in touch with the Emperor! You said we'd sit tight and suck it up no matter what until then!”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっ、バカ！　言うなって！」
lines.english: “Hey, idiot! You weren't supposed to tell him!”

lines.japanese: 「ああなるほどね」
lines.english: “Oh. Now I get it.”

lines.japanese: つまりカケルくんとの橋渡しをしてほしいってことか。
lines.english: So they wanted me to act as a go-between with Kakeru.

lines.japanese: 「でもムリだよ。だって俺、カケルくんの家とか知らないし」
lines.english: “Can't. I don't even know where Kakeru lives.”

lines.japanese: 「あーっ、そんなら俺たちが連れてってやるからさあ、頼むよ隼人先輩～」
lines.english: “Then we'll drive you there! Come on, Hayato, please?”

lines.japanese: 「やだよ、おまえらでなんとかしやがれ。俺を巻きこむな」
lines.english: “No. Deal with it yourselves. Keep me out of this.”

lines.japanese: 「隼人先輩はそう言うけどさあ……」
lines.english: “I know you say that, Hayato, but...”

lines.japanese: 「そうそう、俺たちでダメだったから、成田っちに頼みに来てんじゃーん」
lines.english: “Exactly. We already tried dealing with it ourselves. That's why we came to you, Naritaaa.”

lines.japanese: 「ていうか、なんでそんなにカケルくんにこだわってんの？」
lines.english: “Why are you so hung up on Kakeru, anyway?”

lines.japanese: 「イェア！　よく聞いてくれた成田君！」
lines.english: “Yeeah! Glad you asked, Narita!”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 大したことを聞いたつもりじゃなかったのに、ハゲが指を鳴らして俺に満面の笑みを浮かべていた。
lines.english: I hadn't thought it much of a question, but Baldy snapped his fingers and beamed at me.

lines.japanese: 「いやネー、俺ら『ＹＦＢ』って幾つかのチームが集まって出来てるのね」
lines.english: “See, YFB is like a federation of a bunch of different crews.”

lines.japanese: 「い、いやいいよ、そんな、おまえらの歴史なんて語りださないでよ」
lines.english: “N-no, that's fine. Please don't start giving me your origin story.”

lines.japanese: 「ちゅーか、まぁ、翔さんの存在感ってスゲーもんあったし？　んだから、まとまってたんだって改めて思い知らされたっつーカンジでー、いま俺らの言うこと聞かネー連中も結構いるんスわ！」
lines.english: “I mean, Kakeru's presence was seriously huge, y'know? We're finding out all over again he was what held us together. Now there's a whole bunch of guys who won't listen to us!”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、そうなんだ……ってだからいいって、うわあ聞きたくない聞きたくない」
lines.english: “Oh, really...? No, I said that's enough. La-la-la, I don't wanna hear it.”

lines.japanese: 俺が耳の穴に人差し指を突っこんで上下に揺らした。
lines.english: I stuck an index finger in my ear and waggled it up and down.

lines.japanese: 「ワレワレハウチュウジンダ、ワレワレハウチュウジンダ」
lines.english: “WE—ARE—A—LI—ENS. WE—ARE—A—LI—ENS.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなワケで最近集まりも悪ぃんだけど」
lines.english: “So anyway, turnout's been pretty lousy lately.”

lines.japanese: しかしハゲが俺の腕をつかんで、その腕力にものを言わせて耳の穴から指を離してしまった。
lines.english: Baldy grabbed my arm and used brute force to pull my finger out of my ear.

lines.japanese: 「中でも鬼ウゼーのが、Ｒ－ウイングって連中なんスよ。隼人先輩覚えてます？　あの真っ黒いゴスだかＶ系だかのカッコした連中」
lines.english: “The worst are these R-Wing guys. Remember them, Hayato? The ones all in black, dressed like goths or glam-goth rockers?”

lines.japanese: 「つか見た目から怪しい連中なんスけど、もーアイツらアホですよ、マジ一度見てほしいんスよ、あいつらと話してください、鬼ビビリますよ。ちゅーかなんつの、サイコっつーの？　いってみりゃコレっスわ」
lines.english: “They look sketchy to begin with, but those guys are total lunatics. Seriously, you gotta see them sometime. Try talking to them—you'll lose your shit. What do you call it? Psycho? Basically, they're like this.”

lines.japanese: ギャル男は頭の上でくるくると指を何度か回した。まあ確かにＲ－ウイングの連中のインパクトは一度見たら忘れられるもんじゃないし、迷惑がる気持ちも分からんでもない。
lines.english: The flashy club kid twirled a finger beside his temple a few times. It was true that R-Wing made an impression you didn't forget. I couldn't exactly blame him for finding them a nuisance.

lines.japanese: 「でもフレイムバーズがあいつらを吸収したんだろ。だったらちゃんと責任持って一緒に遊んでやれよ」
lines.english: “But the Flame Birds absorbed them. Take responsibility and play nicely together.”

lines.japanese: 「いやね！　そーなんスけどね！　確かにやつらが白旗あげたから、俺ら受けいれましたけどね！」
lines.english: “I know! I mean, sure, we took them in after they raised the white flag!”

lines.japanese: ギャル男は開き直ったかのように声の音量を一段階上げた。
lines.english: The flashy club kid raised his voice a notch, as though daring me to argue.

lines.japanese: 「でも、あれスよ、俺らライオンだとしたら、あいつらヘビみたいなもんでしょ？　一緒に生活できる生き物じゃないんスよ！　俺らだってあいつらと打ち解けようと努力はしたんスよ！」
lines.english: “But, like, say we're lions. Those guys are snakes, right? Those aren't animals that can live together! And we did try to get along with them!”

lines.japanese: 「し、知るかバカ、ていうかそれを言ったら俺もおまえらとは生息地帯が違うんだよ、空を飛ぶコンドルなんだよ」
lines.english: “H-how should I know, idiot? By that logic, you and I live in different habitats too. I'm a condor soaring through the sky.”

lines.japanese: 「例えばー、そーねー、一緒にファミレス行ったりするでしょ？」
lines.english: “Like, say we all go to a chain diner together, right?”

lines.japanese: 「聞けよ。俺も空を飛ぶコンドルなんだよ、孤高の猛禽類なんだよ」
lines.english: “Listen to me. I'm a condor soaring through the sky. A solitary bird of prey.”

lines.japanese: 「でもあの子たち、俺らが会話のキャッチボールしようと思って話題投げても、化学調味料の種類について延々と語りあってんだぜぇ？　そんなん、歩み寄りようもないジャン」
lines.english: “But even when we toss them a topic and try to get a conversation going, those boys just sit there forever discussing all the different kinds of artificial flavoring. How are we supposed to meet them halfway?”

lines.japanese: 「うわあ……」
lines.english: “Oh God...”

lines.japanese: 感情移入すまいと思っていたのに、その光景がまざまざと浮かんで不覚にも同情してしまった。しかもＲ－ウイングの連中は隅っこに陣取るんだろうなあ。
lines.english: I had sworn I wouldn't sympathize, but the picture came to life so vividly that I did despite myself. R-Wing probably claimed a corner booth, too.

lines.japanese: 「大体、あいつらとは音楽の趣味が合わねんだよな。俺のソウルにまるで響いて来ねえぜ」
lines.english: “Besides, we got no taste in music in common. Their shit doesn't speak to my soul at all.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、それについてはおまえも似たり寄ったりだから」
lines.english: “You're every bit as bad on that front.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ分かるぜ、成田君のソウルは東海岸寄りだもんな」
lines.english: “Hey, I get it. Your soul leans East Coast, Narita.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、まったく」
lines.english: “Not in the slightest.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだ成田君も西海岸がお好みだったのかい、ハッハー」
lines.english: “What, you're a West Coast man too, Narita? Hah-hah!”

lines.japanese: 「いや、まったく」
lines.english: “Not in the slightest.”

lines.japanese: 「もともと俺らに敵意剥き出しの連中だったし、近いうちに反乱起こしてくっかもなー。つか一度シメといた方がいんスよ」
lines.english: “They were openly hostile to us from the start. Might be they'll launch a rebellion soon. Really, we oughta smack them down once and get it over with.”

lines.japanese: 「そしたら成田っちは俺らの味方してくれるんでしょー？」
lines.english: “And when that happens, you'll take our side, won't you, Naritaaa?”

lines.japanese: 「しないに決まってんだろ、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ。俺はどっちの味方でもないってさっき言っただろ、孤高のコンドルなんだよ。世界が平和でありますように！」
lines.english: “Of course I won't. I'll fucking kill you, asshole. I told you I'm on neither side. I'm the solitary condor. *May peace prevail on Earth*.”

lines.japanese: 「ようし、話は決まった！　成田君さえ俺らの味方に付いてくれれば、怖いものなんて何もないぜ、なあ？」
lines.english: “All right, it's settled! With Narita on our side, we got nothing to fear. Right?”

lines.japanese: 「決めんなよ。味方でもなんでもねえよ」
lines.english: “Don't decide that for me. I'm not on anybody's side.”

lines.japanese: 「よっしゃきたきたあ！　よ～し戦勝祈願に、俺スッパー！　もういっちょスッパー！」
lines.english: “Yes! Here we go! A victory prayer—puff! And one more puff!”

lines.japanese: 「おまえもキメんなよ！　タバコ的なものを！」
lines.english: “Don't you go getting high either! Not on whatever that tobacco-ish shit is!”

lines.japanese: 「ひゃっひゃっひゃ、面白くなってきましたネー！　よっしゃ、そんじゃ俺、やつらに反乱起こすように言ってくんわ！」
lines.english: “Hyah-hah-hah! Now this is getting interesting! All right, I'll go tell those guys to start a rebellion!”

lines.japanese: 「あーも、帰れ帰れ。二度とひとの職場来るんじゃないぞ」
lines.english: “Oh, just go home. Go on, get outta here. And never come to my workplace again.”

lines.japanese: 連中は自分たちの言いたいことだけ言うと、車をぶっ飛ばして帰っていった。
lines.english: Having said everything they wanted to say, they tore off in the car.

lines.japanese: なんだったんだよ、もう……見事に休憩時間を使い果たした俺は、おでん味のアメリカンドッグを咥えながら職場に戻った。
lines.english: What the hell was that...? My entire break gone, I returned to work with a hotpot-flavored corn dog clamped between my teeth.
